title: Tower coherence for scalar transport of compact-support arrows
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], a prime $\ell\ne p$, finite extensions $E_0\subset E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a separated finite-type morphism $f:X\to Y$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and completed coefficient sheaves $R_{L,W}=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,W}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For $W=X,Y$ let $A_W=C_{E/E_0,W}$, $B_W=C_{F/E,W}$ and $D_W=C_{F/E_0,W}$ be ordinary derived extensions $C_{H/L,W}(-)=(-)\otimes^L_{R_{L,W}}R_{H,W}$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], with their identification with completed strict-tower scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Write $\alpha^W:B_WA_W\xrightarrow{\sim}D_W$ for the natural tensor associator. Put $P_L=Rf_{!,L}$ using [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], and use precisely the canonical natural coefficient comparisons of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison].
Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_{E_0})$ and $V\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\mathcal O_{E_0})$, the derived-complete constructible categories with a uniform Tor interval [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Assume also $A_XM\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E)$. For any morphism $t:P_{E_0}M\to V$ define
$$\tau_E=A_Y(t)\circ c_{E/E_0,M}^{-1}:P_EA_XM\to A_YV,\qquad \tau_F=D_Y(t)\circ c_{F/E_0,M}^{-1}:P_FD_XM\to D_YV.$$
Then the specified comparison maps give the equality of morphisms from $B_YP_EA_XM$ to $D_YV$,
$$\tau_F\circ P_F(\alpha^X_M)\circ c_{F/E,A_XM}=\alpha^Y_V\circ B_Y(\tau_E).$$
This assertion concerns arbitrary $t$ and $V$; it imposes no smoothness on $f$, no twist on $M$ and no coefficient-unit identification on $V$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] with its coefficient fields $(E,F,L)$ replaced by $(E_0,E,F)$. Its hypotheses hold: $f$ is separated of finite type between separated finite-type schemes, $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_{E_0})$, and the intermediate input $A_XM\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\mathcal O_E)$ is assumed. Set $c_A=c_{E/E_0,M}$, $c_B=c_{F/E,A_XM}$, $c_D=c_{F/E_0,M}$ and $a=\alpha^Y_{P_{E_0}M}$. The cited composition law, for the very comparisons used in the statement, reads $$c_D\circ a=P_F(\alpha^X_M)\circ c_B\circ B_Y(c_A).$$ The three components $c_A,c_B,c_D$ are isomorphisms by that same cited statement. This equality has source $B_YA_YP_{E_0}M$ and target $P_FD_XM$; it requires no purity or smoothness.

proof.text: Postcompose the equality of Step 1 with $c_D^{-1}$ and precompose it with $B_Y(c_A^{-1})$. Functoriality gives $B_Y(c_A)\circ B_Y(c_A^{-1})=B_Y(c_A\circ c_A^{-1})=1$, so cancellation yields $$c_D^{-1}\circ P_F(\alpha^X_M)\circ c_B=a\circ B_Y(c_A^{-1}).$$ Both sides are morphisms $B_YP_EA_XM\to D_YP_{E_0}M$. Only associativity, the inverse identities and preservation of composition and identities by $B_Y$ are used.

source.place: Coefficient-extension transport, expanded from sk-thm-purity-transport.proof.md Step 3; agent-written categorical calculation using the specified compact-support coefficient comparison

proof.text: The given natural associator $\alpha^Y:B_YA_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}D_Y$, evaluated on the arbitrary arrow $t:P_{E_0}M\to V$, satisfies its defining naturality equation $$D_Y(t)\circ a=\alpha^Y_V\circ B_Y(A_Y(t)).$$ Compose Step 2 with $D_Y(t)$ and substitute this equation. The definitions of $\tau_F$ and $\tau_E$ and functoriality of $B_Y$ give $$\tau_F\circ P_F(\alpha^X_M)\circ c_B=D_Y(t)\circ a\circ B_Y(c_A^{-1})=\alpha^Y_V\circ B_Y(A_Y(t)\circ c_A^{-1})=\alpha^Y_V\circ B_Y(\tau_E),$$ as required. Naturality applies in the ambient derived category, so it does not require a coefficient-unit identification of $V$ or an additional constructibility assertion for $P_{E_0}M$.
